metadata.name: private_loan
metadata.description: Lendspan private loan protocol on MagicBlock Private Ephemeral Rollups

instructions.name: accept_loan
docs: Ephemeral rollup. Borrower accepts `revision`: collateral in, principal out.

accounts.name: anchor
docs: Writable: on first acceptance it pays rent for the room deal record.

instructions.name: ai_callback
docs: Ephemeral rollup. The worker stores the typed answer once.

instructions.name: cancel_loan
docs: Ephemeral rollup. Lender cancels before acceptance; principal returns.

instructions.name: check_price
docs: Ephemeral rollup. Runs the shared Pyth check against the cloned receiver account.

instructions.name: claim_expired
docs: Ephemeral rollup. Anyone, at or after the deadline: collateral to the lender.

instructions.name: crank_tick
docs: Ephemeral rollup. Permissionless scheduled tick; a no-op once settled.

instructions.name: create_ai_request
docs: Ephemeral rollup. A member binds an approved excerpt hash (and loan revision) to a request.

instructions.name: create_custody
docs: Base layer. Creates a custody PDA, its ATA, and its eATA.

instructions.name: create_loan
docs: Base layer. Creates the loan anchor and its two empty, delegated eATAs.

accounts.name: usdc_ata
docs: Base token accounts the ER mirrors for this loan's custody. Without them
the custody ATAs do not exist inside the rollup.

instructions.name: create_probe
docs: Base layer. Creates the probe and its permission in one instruction.

instructions.name: create_record
docs: Ephemeral rollup. Creates a private ER-only record sponsored by the probe.

instructions.name: create_session
docs: Ephemeral rollup. A member authorises a session key for nonfinancial actions.

instructions.name: custody_transfer
docs: Ephemeral rollup. Custody PDA signs an SPL transfer out of its own ATA.

instructions.name: delegate_loan
docs: Base layer. Delegates the loan anchor (same transaction as `create_loan`).

instructions.name: delegate_probe
docs: Base layer. Delegates the permission and the probe to the TEE validator.

instructions.name: delegate_room
docs: Base layer. Delegates the room anchor to the TEE (same transaction as `open_room`).

instructions.name: edit_terms
docs: Ephemeral rollup. Lender edits terms before funding; the revision moves.

instructions.name: fund_and_delegate
docs: Base layer. Moves tokens into the custody eATA and delegates it to the TEE.

instructions.name: fund_loan
docs: Ephemeral rollup. Lender locks the principal for `revision`.

instructions.name: init_room
docs: Ephemeral rollup. Creates the private member list and thread.

instructions.name: invite_member
docs: Ephemeral rollup. Owner adds a member and widens both permissions.

instructions.name: open_join_queue
docs: Ephemeral rollup. Owner creates the join queue only they can read.

instructions.name: open_room
docs: Base layer. Creates the room anchor and funds it to sponsor private records.

instructions.name: post_message
docs: Ephemeral rollup. A member, or a session with post scope, posts a message.

accounts.name: signer
docs: The member's wallet, or a session key with `SCOPE_POST_MESSAGE`.

instructions.name: propose_terms
docs: Ephemeral rollup. Lender proposes exact terms to a borrower in the same room.

instructions.name: publish_card
docs: Base layer. Room owner publishes an opt-in public card with chosen fields.

accounts.name: room
docs: The room anchor on Solana. Delegated, so read through its stored creator only.

instructions.name: repay_loan
docs: Ephemeral rollup. Borrower repays the exact debt before the deadline.

accounts.name: anchor
docs: Writable: on first acceptance it pays rent for the room deal record.

instructions.name: request_join
docs: Ephemeral rollup. Anyone asks to join a room from its public card.

instructions.name: retract_card
docs: Base layer. Publisher removes the card and reclaims rent.

instructions.name: revoke_member
docs: Ephemeral rollup. Owner removes a member and narrows both permissions.

instructions.name: revoke_session
docs: Ephemeral rollup. The authorising wallet revokes its session.

instructions.name: schedule_tick
docs: Ephemeral rollup. Creates a Hydra crank for `crank_tick`, sponsored by the probe.

instructions.name: set_ai_worker
docs: Base layer. Admin sets the AI worker key and turns the copilot on or off.

instructions.name: undelegate_custody
docs: Ephemeral rollup. Returns the custody eATA to the base layer.

instructions.name: undelegate_probe
docs: Ephemeral rollup. Commits and undelegates the probe back to the base layer.

instructions.name: withdraw_custody
docs: Base layer. Withdraws from the global vault to the authority.

instructions.name: write_probe
docs: Ephemeral rollup. Writes a value only the permitted members can read.

errors.name: MathOverflow
errors.msg: Arithmetic overflow

errors.name: InvalidTerms
errors.msg: Interest rate, term, or LTV is outside allowed caps

errors.name: InvalidPriceOwner

errors.name: InvalidFeedId

errors.name: StalePrice

errors.name: InvalidPrice

errors.name: InvalidExponent
errors.msg: Price exponent is outside the allowed range

errors.name: ZeroCollateralValue

errors.name: Unauthorized

errors.name: InvalidRecord
errors.msg: Record is missing or malformed

errors.name: NotRoomOwner

errors.name: RoomAlreadyInitialized
errors.msg: Room is already initialized

errors.name: NotMember

errors.name: AlreadyMember

errors.name: SessionTooLong

errors.name: SessionScope

errors.name: SessionRevoked

errors.name: SessionExpired

errors.name: MessageTooLong

errors.name: WrongRoom

errors.name: NotLender

errors.name: NotBorrower
errors.msg: Signer is not this loan's borrower

errors.name: WrongStatus
errors.msg: Loan is not in the required status

errors.name: StaleRevision
errors.msg: Terms changed since this approval; review the current revision

errors.name: WrongTokenAccount
errors.msg: Token account is not the expected one for this party and mint

errors.name: InsufficientCollateral

errors.name: LoanExpired

errors.name: LoanNotExpired

errors.name: CompetingOfferAccepted

errors.name: AiDisabled
errors.msg: The AI copilot is turned off

errors.name: NotAiWorker
errors.msg: Only the configured AI worker may answer

errors.name: AlreadyAnswered
errors.msg: This request was already answered

errors.name: RequestExpired
errors.msg: This request expired before an answer arrived

fields.name: collateral_note
docs: Human-readable collateral note, e.g. "wSOL at up to 60% LTV".

fields.name: room
docs: Room the loan was agreed in. An opaque id; it names no wallet.
